ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) PROCUREMENT OF TACTICAL HARNESS WITH BULLET-RESISTAN T PLATES THROUGH GeM 1. GENERAL 1.1. The item to be procured shall be Tactical Harness with Bullet-Resistant Plates, conforming to the tech nical specifications stipulated in the bid. 1.2. The supplied items shall be brand new, unused, of current manufacture and free from manufacturing defects. 1.3. The bidder shall be the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or an authorised dealer/distributor of t he OEM. Authorisation documents shall be submitted wherever applicable. 2. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS Ser N Parameter Minimum Technical Requirement o. (a) Item Tactical Harness with Bullet-Resistant Plates (b) Design Ergonomic, adjustable tactical vest/harness suitable for field use (c) Material High-strength, abrasion-resistant and tear-resistant fabric (d) Stitching Reinforced stitching at stress points (e) Adjustability Adjustable shoulder straps and side closures (f) Plate Pockets Dedicated pockets for secure fitting of ballistic plates (g) Plate Configuration Front and rear bullet-resistant plates (h) Plate Material Certified ballistic-grade material (i) Ballistic Protection As specified in the bid schedule and supported by valid ballistic test reports (j) Plate Retention Secure retention system to prevent displacement during movement Load-Bearing Arrange (k) Suitable arrangement for carrying compatible tactical equipment ment (l) Inner Lining Breathable and comfortable lining suitable for prolonged wear (m) Colour Olive Green or other colour specified in the bid (n) Size Adjustable or available in the sizes specified by the purchaser (o) Accessories All components necessary for proper fitting and use of the supplied set Manufacturer's technical datasheet, warranty certificate and applicable balli (p) Documentation stic test reports 3. BALLISTIC PROTECTION AND CERTIFICATION 3.1. The ballistic plates shall conform to the protection level and applicable Indian standard or other recog nised ballistic standard expressly specified in the bid. 3.2. The bidder shall submit valid ballistic test reports issued by a competent laboratory accredited for the relevant test method. 3.3. The test reports shall clearly identify the tested product, protection level, applicable standard and ma nufacturer, and shall be traceable to the offered product. 3.4. The bidder shall provide manufacturer identification, batch/serial numbers and manufacturing details, wherever applicable. 3.5. The supplied ballistic plates shall be compatible with the offered harness and shall fit securely in the d esignated plate pockets. 3.6. Any claim regarding ballistic protection shall be supported by documentary evidence. Unsupported cl aims shall not be accepted as proof of compliance.

4. BIDDER ELIGIBILITY AND DOCUMENTS 4.1. The bidder shall upload the following documents with the bid, wherever applicable: (a) Manufacturer's technical datasheet of the offered product. (b) OEM authorisation certificate, where the bidder is not the manufacturer. (c) Valid ballistic test reports for the offered plates. (d) Details of the applicable Indian or recognised international standard. (e) Warranty certificate or undertaking. (f) Declaration confirming that the offered product meets all stipulated technical specifications. 4.2. The purchaser reserves the right to seek clarification regarding submitted technical documents in acc ordance with applicable GeM bid conditions. 5. INSPECTION AND ACCEPTANCE 5.1. The supplied items shall be inspected by the designated inspection authority. 5.2. Inspection shall include verification of quantity, dimensions, workmanship, stitching, plate fitment, ide ntification markings and conformity with the approved technical specifications. 5.3. The ballistic certification and traceability documents shall be verified before acceptance. 5.4. Any item found damaged, defective, incomplete or non-conforming to the accepted specifications shal l be replaced by the supplier without additional cost to the purchaser, subject to the contract conditions. 5.5. Payment and acceptance shall be governed by the applicable GeM contract terms and the prescribed i nspection and receipt procedures. 6. WARRANTY 6.1. The harness and associated non-ballistic components shall carry a minimum warranty of one year aga inst manufacturing defects from the date of acceptance, unless a longer period is specified in the bid. 6.2. The ballistic plates shall carry the manufacturer's declared warranty and service-life provisions, which shall be clearly stated in the bid documents. 6.3. The supplier shall replace defective items covered under warranty without additional cost to the purch aser, in accordance with the contract conditions. 7. DELIVERY 7.1. The supplier shall deliver the complete quantity within the delivery period specified in the GeM bid or contract. 7.2. The supplied items shall include all components and accessories specified in the contract. 7.3. The items shall be securely packed to prevent damage during transportation and handling. 7.4. Delivery shall be made to the consignee and at the location specified in the GeM contract. 8. REJECTION OF STORES 8.1. The purchaser reserves the right to reject items that fail to meet the stipulated technical specifications, applicable certification requirements or accepted quality standards. 8.2. Rejected items shall be replaced by the supplier within the period stipulated by the purchaser, in acco rdance with the contract conditions. 8.3. All costs associated with replacement of rejected items shall be borne by the supplier, subject to the c ontract terms. 9. GENERAL CONDITIONS

9.1. The bidder shall quote for the complete item as specified in the bid. 9.2. The offered product shall conform to the technical specifications and applicable standards stated in th e bid. 9.3. No deviation from the stipulated technical specifications shall be permitted unless expressly accepted by the purchaser through the applicable procurement process. 9.4. All provisions of the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), applicable bid conditions and resulting contract shall remain applicable. 9.5. In the event of any inconsistency, the applicable GeM GTC, contract provisions and valid bid-specific c onditions shall govern, subject to applicable procurement rules. 10. COMPLIANCE The bidder shall submit a clause-by-clause compliance statement against the technical specifications ment ioned in the bid. Each parameter shall be marked as “Complied” or “Not Complied”, with supporting techni cal documents wherever required. .
